tagline.en_US: A self-hosted Z-Wave control panel and MQTT gateway. Its web interface can start without a Z-Wave controller; device control requires a compatible USB or serial controller and network security keys.

description.en_US: Z-Wave JS UI is a control panel and MQTT gateway for Z-Wave networks. It enables users to add, remove, configure, and monitor Z-Wave devices and their values through a web interface. The application can expose network devices to an MQTT broker, visualize node communication paths with a network graph, and perform diagnostics and firmware updates.
